title: 日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 以 SPring-8 的 8 GeV、1436 m 儲存環為對象，先理解高電子能量如何讓真空內波盪器的基頻直接落在硬 X 光，再拆解 SACLA 直線加速器直接注入、束團純度量測與同調分率的工程，最後推導 SPring-8-II 為何改用 6 GeV 五彎消色散晶格加阻尼扭擺磁鐵，把發射度從 2.4 nm·rad 壓到 50 pm·rad 並在同一隧道內更換整座環。
summaryEn: Using SPring-8's 8 GeV, 1436 m ring, first see how high electron energy puts the fundamental of an in-vacuum undulator directly in the hard X-ray range, then work through direct injection from the SACLA linac, bunch-purity measurement and coherent-fraction engineering, and finally derive why SPring-8-II moves to a 6 GeV five-bend achromat with damping wigglers to cut emittance from 2.4 nm·rad to 50 pm·rad while replacing the whole ring inside the same tunnel.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」與「發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary" and "Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8 選擇 8 GeV，是為了讓彎轉磁鐵的臨界能量落在數十 keV，並讓波盪器的基頻直接涵蓋 10 keV 以上的硬 X 光。代價是輻射損失隨 E⁴ 暴增：每圈損失接近 10 MeV，必須由 508.58 MHz 的射頻系統補回；周長 1435.95 m 給出 2436 個束團桶與 208.8 kHz 的迴轉頻率，4 段 30 m 長直線段則容納超長波盪器。這組邊界條件決定了射頻功率、真空腔的熱負載與整座設施的用電。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: SPring-8 chose 8 GeV so that the bending-magnet critical energy lands at tens of keV and undulator fundamentals cover hard X-rays above 10 keV directly. The price is radiation loss growing as E⁴: nearly 10 MeV per turn must be restored by the 508.58 MHz RF system; the 1435.95 m circumference gives 2436 buckets and a 208.8 kHz revolution frequency, and four 30 m straights house very long undulators. These boundary conditions fix RF power, chamber heat load and the facility's electricity use. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The price is radiation loss growing as E⁴: nearly 10 MeV per turn must be restored by the 508.58 MHz RF system; the 1435.95 m circumference gives 2436 buckets and a 208.8 kHz revolution frequency, and four 30 m straights house very long undulators.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施」的「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: mechanism and system boundary” in “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary" is correct?
options: 電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。
SPring-8 選擇 8 GeV，是為了讓彎轉磁鐵的臨界能量落在數十 keV，並讓波盪器的基頻直接涵蓋 10 keV 以上的硬 X 光。
降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
optionsEn: Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss.
SPring-8 chose 8 GeV so that the bending-magnet critical energy lands at tens of keV and undulator fundamentals cover hard X-rays above 10 keV directly.
Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
quiz.explanation: SPring-8 選擇 8 GeV，是為了讓彎轉磁鐵的臨界能量落在數十 keV，並讓波盪器的基頻直接涵蓋 10 keV 以上的硬 X 光。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: SPring-8 chose 8 GeV so that the bending-magnet critical energy lands at tens of keV and undulator fundamentals cover hard X-rays above 10 keV directly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臨界能量 ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV。每圈損失 U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV，100 mA 時 P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW（未含插件磁鐵）。諧波數 h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436，迴轉頻率 c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV. Loss per turn U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV, so at 100 mA P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW before insertion devices. Harmonic number h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436 and the revolution frequency is c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV. Loss per turn U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV, so at 100 mA P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW before insertion devices. Harmonic number h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436 and the revolution frequency is c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary", which statement holds?
options: 注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。
總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。
optionsEn: An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.
If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.
Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV.
quiz.explanation: 臨界能量 ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary"?
options: 從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
optionsEn: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
quiz.explanation: 從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這組邊界條件決定了射頻功率、真空腔的熱負載與整座設施的用電。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These boundary conditions fix RF power, chamber heat load and the facility's electricity use.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。
knowledge.textEn: Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。
降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost.
Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
quiz.explanation: 把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」如何決定日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat” determines the key performance of “SPring-8 synchrotron facility”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPring-8 現行雙彎消色散晶格的水平發射度約 2.4 nm·rad。SPring-8-II 把能量降到 6 GeV 並換成每單元五個彎轉的五彎消色散，彎轉角立方的縮減讓裸晶格發射度降到約 111 pm·rad；再用阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加輻射阻尼，把發射度壓到約 50 pm·rad，電流提高到 200 mA。降能損失的光子能量由更短週期的真空內波盪器補回，而輻射損失與用電反而下降，這是「綠色升級」的核心取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The present double-bend achromat of SPring-8 has a horizontal emittance of about 2.4 nm·rad. SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV and adopts a five-bend achromat with five bends per cell; the cube of the smaller bend angle brings the bare-lattice emittance to about 111 pm·rad, damping wigglers then add radiation damping to reach about 50 pm·rad, and the current rises to 200 mA. The photon energy lost by lowering the energy is recovered with shorter-period in-vacuum undulators, while radiation loss and electricity fall, which is the central trade-off of the green upgrade. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³：現行 88 彎、8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸，θ = 71.4 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645）得 ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad，與實際 2.4 nm 相符。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³: the present 88 bends at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸, θ = 71.4 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645) give ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad, consistent with the actual 2.4 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨
knowledge.titleEn: Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy
knowledge.text: SPring-8 現行雙彎消色散晶格的水平發射度約 2.4 nm·rad。SPring-8-II 把能量降到 6 GeV 並換成每單元五個彎轉的五彎消色散，彎轉角立方的縮減讓裸晶格發射度降到約 111 pm·rad；再用阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加輻射阻尼，把發射度壓到約 50 pm·rad，電流提高到 200 mA。
knowledge.textEn: The present double-bend achromat of SPring-8 has a horizontal emittance of about 2.4 nm·rad. SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV and adopts a five-bend achromat with five bends per cell; the cube of the smaller bend angle brings the bare-lattice emittance to about 111 pm·rad, damping wigglers then add radiation damping to reach about 50 pm·rad, and the current rises to 200 mA.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy" is correct?
options: 降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。
波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。
SPring-8 現行雙彎消色散晶格的水平發射度約 2.4 nm·rad。
optionsEn: Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.
Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy.
The present double-bend achromat of SPring-8 has a horizontal emittance of about 2.4 nm·rad.
quiz.explanation: SPring-8 現行雙彎消色散晶格的水平發射度約 2.4 nm·rad。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The present double-bend achromat of SPring-8 has a horizontal emittance of about 2.4 nm·rad. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³：現行 88 彎、8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸，θ = 71.4 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645）得 ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad，與實際 2.4 nm 相符。SPring-8-II 220 彎、6 GeV（γ² = 1.38×10⁸，θ = 28.6 mrad）：同一 F 給 79 pm，理論極限 F_TME = 0.0215 給 26 pm，設計裸發射度 111 pm。阻尼扭擺磁鐵：ε = ε₀/(1 + U_w/U₀)，要從 111 降到 50 pm 需 U_w/U₀ ≈ 1.2，即扭擺磁鐵的輻射損失約為彎轉磁鐵的 1.2 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³: the present 88 bends at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸, θ = 71.4 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645) give ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad, consistent with the actual 2.4 nm. SPring-8-II with 220 bends at 6 GeV (γ² = 1.38×10⁸, θ = 28.6 mrad): the same F gives 79 pm, the TME limit F = 0.0215 gives 26 pm, and the design bare emittance is 111 pm. Damping wigglers: ε = ε₀/(1 + U_w/U₀), so going from 111 to 50 pm needs U_w/U₀ ≈ 1.2, that is wiggler radiation loss about 1.2 times that of the bends. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 X 光針孔相機或干涉式尺寸監視器在已知 β 處量束流尺寸反推發射度；逐步關閉阻尼扭擺磁鐵間隙，記錄發射度隨扭擺輻射損失（由射頻功率增量推得）的變化，核對 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) 關係；同時監看能散與束團長度，因為扭擺磁鐵也會改變它們。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure beam size at a point of known β with an X-ray pinhole camera or interferometric size monitor and invert to emittance; close the damping-wiggler gaps step by step, log emittance versus wiggler radiation loss (inferred from the RF power increment) and check the 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) relation; also watch energy spread and bunch length, since wigglers change those too.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³：現行 88 彎、8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸，θ = 71.4 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645）得 ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad，與實際 2.4 nm 相符。SPring-8-II 220 彎、6 GeV（γ² = 1.38×10⁸，θ = 28.6 mrad）：同一 F 給 79 pm，理論極限 F_TME = 0.0215 給 26 pm，設計裸發射度 111 pm。阻尼扭擺磁鐵：ε = ε₀/(1 + U_w/U₀)，要從 111 降到 50 pm 需 U_w/U₀ ≈ 1.2，即扭擺磁鐵的輻射損失約為彎轉磁鐵的 1.2 倍。
knowledge.textEn: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³: the present 88 bends at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸, θ = 71.4 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645) give ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad, consistent with the actual 2.4 nm. SPring-8-II with 220 bends at 6 GeV (γ² = 1.38×10⁸, θ = 28.6 mrad): the same F gives 79 pm, the TME limit F = 0.0215 gives 26 pm, and the design bare emittance is 111 pm. Damping wigglers: ε = ε₀/(1 + U_w/U₀), so going from 111 to 50 pm needs U_w/U₀ ≈ 1.2, that is wiggler radiation loss about 1.2 times that of the bends.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy", which statement holds?
options: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³：現行 88 彎、8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸，θ = 71.4 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645）得 ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad，與實際 2.4 nm 相符。
只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。
隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。
optionsEn: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³: the present 88 bends at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸, θ = 71.4 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645) give ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad, consistent with the actual 2.4 nm.
Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.
If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.
quiz.explanation: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³：現行 88 彎、8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸，θ = 71.4 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645）得 ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad，與實際 2.4 nm 相符。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³: the present 88 bends at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸, θ = 71.4 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645) give ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad, consistent with the actual 2.4 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 X 光針孔相機或干涉式尺寸監視器在已知 β 處量束流尺寸反推發射度；逐步關閉阻尼扭擺磁鐵間隙，記錄發射度隨扭擺輻射損失（由射頻功率增量推得）的變化，核對 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) 關係；同時監看能散與束團長度，因為扭擺磁鐵也會改變它們。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure beam size at a point of known β with an X-ray pinhole camera or interferometric size monitor and invert to emittance; close the damping-wiggler gaps step by step, log emittance versus wiggler radiation loss (inferred from the RF power increment) and check the 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) relation; also watch energy spread and bunch length, since wigglers change those too. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：阻尼扭擺磁鐵若放在色散不為零的位置，自身的量子激發會抵銷阻尼效果，發射度不降反升；設計時若只看阻尼項而忽略色散，整個 50 pm 的目標就落空。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Damping wigglers placed where dispersion is non-zero add their own quantum excitation that cancels the damping, and emittance rises instead of falling; a design that counts only the damping term and ignores dispersion misses the whole 50 pm target.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 X 光針孔相機或干涉式尺寸監視器在已知 β 處量束流尺寸反推發射度；逐步關閉阻尼扭擺磁鐵間隙，記錄發射度隨扭擺輻射損失（由射頻功率增量推得）的變化，核對 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) 關係；同時監看能散與束團長度，因為扭擺磁鐵也會改變它們。
knowledge.textEn: Measure beam size at a point of known β with an X-ray pinhole camera or interferometric size monitor and invert to emittance; close the damping-wiggler gaps step by step, log emittance versus wiggler radiation loss (inferred from the RF power increment) and check the 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) relation; also watch energy spread and bunch length, since wigglers change those too.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 X 光針孔相機或干涉式尺寸監視器在已知 β 處量束流尺寸反推發射度。
升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure beam size at a point of known β with an X-ray pinhole camera or interferometric size monitor and invert to emittance.
Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.
quiz.explanation: 以 X 光針孔相機或干涉式尺寸監視器在已知 β 處量束流尺寸反推發射度；逐步關閉阻尼扭擺磁鐵間隙，記錄發射度隨扭擺輻射損失（由射頻功率增量推得）的變化，核對 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) 關係；同時監看能散與束團長度，因為扭擺磁鐵也會改變它們。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure beam size at a point of known β with an X-ray pinhole camera or interferometric size monitor and invert to emittance; close the damping-wiggler gaps step by step, log emittance versus wiggler radiation loss (inferred from the RF power increment) and check the 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) relation; also watch energy spread and bunch length, since wigglers change those too. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 阻尼扭擺磁鐵若放在色散不為零的位置，自身的量子激發會抵銷阻尼效果，發射度不降反升；設計時若只看阻尼項而忽略色散，整個 50 pm 的目標就落空。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Damping wigglers placed where dispersion is non-zero add their own quantum excitation that cancels the damping, and emittance rises instead of falling; a design that counts only the damping term and ignores dispersion misses the whole 50 pm target. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：降能損失的光子能量由更短週期的真空內波盪器補回，而輻射損失與用電反而下降，這是「綠色升級」的核心取捨。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The photon energy lost by lowering the energy is recovered with shorter-period in-vacuum undulators, while radiation loss and electricity fall, which is the central trade-off of the green upgrade.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 阻尼扭擺磁鐵若放在色散不為零的位置，自身的量子激發會抵銷阻尼效果，發射度不降反升；設計時若只看阻尼項而忽略色散，整個 50 pm 的目標就落空。
knowledge.textEn: Damping wigglers placed where dispersion is non-zero add their own quantum excitation that cancels the damping, and emittance rises instead of falling; a design that counts only the damping term and ignores dispersion misses the whole 50 pm target.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。
阻尼扭擺磁鐵若放在色散不為零的位置，自身的量子激發會抵銷阻尼效果，發射度不降反升；設計時若只看阻尼項而忽略色散，整個 50 pm 的目標就落空。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy.
Damping wigglers placed where dispersion is non-zero add their own quantum excitation that cancels the damping, and emittance rises instead of falling.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼扭擺磁鐵若放在色散不為零的位置，自身的量子激發會抵銷阻尼效果，發射度不降反升；設計時若只看阻尼項而忽略色散，整個 50 pm 的目標就落空。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Damping wigglers placed where dispersion is non-zero add their own quantum excitation that cancels the damping, and emittance rises instead of falling; a design that counts only the damping term and ignores dispersion misses the whole 50 pm target. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
